basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm Alex, a 28-year-old graphic designer from Toronto, Canada. I've always had a passion for art and design, which led me to pursue a degree in Visual Arts. My love for creativity extends beyond my job; I'm a huge fan of nail art and love experimenting with different styles and colors on my own nails. When I'm not working or doing my nails, I enjoy playing video games, especially RPGs like Genshin Impact. I'm a night owl, often online during late evenings and early mornings. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to explore my hobbies and interests. Despite my creative side, I have a keen interest in linguistics, which is why I frequently visit subreddits like 'Portmanteau'.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a formal education in visual arts and graphic design, which provides me with a strong foundation in aesthetics and creativity. Over the years, I've honed my skills through both academic and practical experiences. My interest in nail art started as a hobby and has become a significant part of my life. I learn new techniques through online tutorials and community observations. Additionally, my curiosity about language has led me to explore and learn about linguistics independently.
